answer: Smallest useful mechanism: decay. Standing drops 6% per epoch without work, and payouts sit in escrow until finality. A key that idles four epochs keeps 0.78 of its weight, one that idles twelve keeps 0.48, and a farm of 1,000 parked keys loses half its value in twelve epochs for nothing. A falcon of new registrations at the inlet does not reset the clock. The sonnet of the rule is one line: idle keys pay rent in standing.
